requirements.requirement: Repair the settlement utility to join payments to invoices, account for multiple payments and signed credits exactly in integer cents, and publish balances.csv with invoice_id and outstanding_cents.
requirements.summary: The repaired utility produced the required schema and correct seeded balances (I100=0, I101=1000, I102=150). A separate 26-digit-cent test, multiple payments, and signed-credit cases passed, demonstrating exact arithmetic beyond normal floating-point precision.

requirements.requirement: Put unknown invoice IDs and malformed amounts in rejected.csv with a reason.
requirements.summary: The published rejected.csv records P4 as unknown_invoice_id and P5 as malformed_amount. The isolated edge test independently exercised both rejection paths.

requirements.requirement: Avoid counting a duplicate payment_id twice.
requirements.summary: The duplicate P3 payment was rejected as duplicate_payment_id and counted only once, yielding I101=1000. An isolated duplicate-ID assertion also passed.
Both source-file SHA-256 hashes after repair and after restart exactly match the preparation baseline.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use software compatible with the legacy platform.
requirements.summary: Alpine 3.23.3 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts remained unchanged. The replacement is an executable POSIX shell/BusyBox awk implementation and ran successfully before and after restart without installing software.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied. The node1 restart protocol is also complete: a healthy pre-restart reconciliation was captured, restart was acknowledged, the boot ID changed, and the utility, outputs, source hashes, OS release, and kernel were verified after recovery. Fixed lifecycle boot identities independently corroborate the restart.
limitations: Systemd failed-service inspection was unsupported on Alpine, although this task installs no daemon and the utility was directly exercised after restart.
Functional evidence covers the seeded data and targeted edge cases, not every possible malformed CSV structure.
Requirement R4 cited unknown evidence IDs: seeded-state-node1

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were observed. The script replacement and output generation directly implemented the task; the temporary edge-test directory was task-relevant and removed by its trap; repeated reconciliation runs collected bounded final/recovery evidence; and the reboot was required by the provider-wide protocol. Failed early executions did not run because the Python interpreters were absent, while restart polling was read-only. Lifecycle observations show no new temporary-file residue, package damage, or listening-service exposure; the socket PID/address changes are consistent with the required reboot.
